passenger.title: VELRO Ride
passenger.short_description: Intercity rides in Afghanistan: name your price, compare drivers' offers.
passenger.full_description:
VELRO books intercity rides between Kabul, Parwan and Ghorband.

You name the price. Choose the station you are leaving from, where you are going, the day and the hour, and what you want to pay. Drivers answer with their own offers, and you choose one. The fare is agreed before anyone gets in the car.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Ask for a ride from a real station to a real destination, today or on a later day, with a return if you need one.
• Compare offers side by side: each driver's price, rating and number of trips, and the car and its plate.
• Keep your booking on your phone: your boarding code, your driver's name and photo, the car, and a button to call.
• Watch the road: the route on the map and, once your driver is on the way, the car on it. When you board, the whole screen becomes the ride map, with warnings about the road ahead.
• Get help fast: emergency numbers you can call without internet, your trip details sent by SMS to someone you trust, and a report straight to VELRO.
• Use the app in Dari, Pashto or English, and switch at any time.

HOW IT WORKS
Your phone number is your account: you sign in with a one-time code, with no password. You pay the driver in cash; there are no payments in the app. You can delete your account from inside the app at any time (Account → Delete account).

WHERE
VELRO serves Kabul, Parwan and Ghorband. A ride can only be requested from inside this area.

ولرو — سفر بین‌شهری میان کابل، پروان و غوربند. قیمت را خودتان بگویید، پیشنهاد راننده‌ها را مقایسه کنید و پیش از سوار شدن کرایه را بدانید. به دری، پښتو و انگلیسی.

driver.title: VELRO Driver
driver.short_description: Find passengers between Kabul, Parwan and Ghorband. Name your fare, drive safe.
driver.full_description:
VELRO Driver is the driver's side of VELRO, the intercity ride service between Kabul, Parwan and Ghorband.

Passengers name the price they want to pay for a seat. You see their requests and answer with your own fare. When a passenger picks your offer, the trip is yours.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Go online to see the passengers who are waiting: where they are going, the day and hour, how many seats, and the fare they are asking.
• Accept the asking fare in one tap, or offer your own, with a note for the passenger.
• Keep each trip on one card: the booking, a button to call the passenger, and each passenger's boarding code to check before you leave.
• Drive with the ride map: your route, and warnings about curves and dangerous stretches of the road ahead.
• See what you earn by day, week and month, your trips, VELRO's commission, and what has been settled.
• Send your driving licence, tazkira and car papers from your phone, and follow their review.
• Get help fast: emergency numbers you can call without internet, and a report straight to VELRO.
• Use the app in Dari, Pashto or English.

HOW IT WORKS
Your phone number is your account: you sign in with a one-time code, with no password. Passengers pay you in cash; there are no payments in the app. Your documents and your car are reviewed before you can go online. While you are online and during a trip the app uses your location to show your car to the passengers you are driving and to warn you about the road ahead, and it shows a notification the whole time. You can delete your account from inside the app at any time (Profile → Delete account).

WHERE
VELRO serves Kabul, Parwan and Ghorband.

ولرو راننده — مسافر پیدا کنید، کرایه خود را بگویید و با اطمینان رانندگی کنید. به دری، پښتو و انگلیسی.
